# IEBP016: dataset_pinning

<!-- Generated by `python -m inspect_evals_lint.docs`; edit the source, not this file. -->

Dataset loads name an immutable commit SHA, and raw asset URLs are pinned to one.

**Category:** best_practices · **Applies to:** eval, helper · **Allowlist:** `[tool.inspect-evals-lint.allowlists.dataset_pinning]`

## What it does

Flags each `hf_dataset(...)`, `load_dataset(...)` or `snapshot_download(...)` call imported from `datasets`, `inspect_ai.dataset` or `huggingface_hub` with no `revision=` keyword, and each whose `revision=` is a string literal that is not a full 40-character hex SHA (`"main"`, `"v1.2"`, a short SHA). A `revision=` that is a name, attribute or call is accepted, since the rule cannot see its value.

A same-named function imported from a local module is a wrapper that may pin the revision itself, and a method call such as `self.load_dataset()` is not a loader call at all; neither is flagged.

Also flags each raw `raw.githubusercontent.com/<org>/<repo>/main/...` or `/master/...` URL, except in a module, class or function docstring, where it is normally a citation rather than an asset the eval downloads.

Each finding is keyed by the dataset identifier or the URL, so an allowlist entry can name one asset while the rest of the repository stays pinned.

## Why is this bad?

A branch or tag resolves to whatever upstream holds when the eval runs. A push upstream then changes the samples, and therefore the scores, with nothing in the repository or the log to show it. A raw `main` URL has the same problem and can change under a force-push. Pinning to a commit SHA makes the run reproducible and the comparison between two runs meaningful.

## Example

```python
from inspect_ai.dataset import hf_dataset

dataset = hf_dataset(path="allenai/ai2_arc", split="test")
```

Use instead:

```python
dataset = hf_dataset(
    path="allenai/ai2_arc",
    split="test",
    revision="2bb88cae8e6b4b1c0a8b2d1e5b3b9a0e4b1c2d3e",
)
```

## Options

- `allowlists.dataset_pinning`: `{ package = ["allenai/ai2_arc"] }` entries reported as warnings while they stay unpinned.
